rules.usav_summary: USA Volleyball 2024-2025 rules include updates on uniform legality (Arabic numerals 1-99 required, contrasting colors for Libero), allowing small, snug-fitting jewelry like nose rings and ear cuffs, and ensuring centered, clearly visible numbers. Protests on judgment decisions are not allowed and may result in a penalty for the coach.
rules.srva_summary: SRVA (Southern Region Volleyball Association) governs regional tournament registrations and club management. All players and staff must be registered via the SRVAonline system. Athletes must 'Accept' Mid TN VBC as their club in the SRVA system to be eligible for tournaments.
rules.expert_info: We follow USA Volleyball and SRVA standards. Key areas include service order, Libero transitions, net contact rules, tournament eligibility, and entry deadlines/roster requirements.

faqs.q: What is the cost of tryouts?
faqs.a: Tryouts cost $50 for pre-registration and $60 for walk-ups.

faqs.q: Where do I sign in for tryouts?
faqs.a: Sign-in is at our facility: 6910 Stroop Ln, Smyrna, TN 37167. Please arrive 30 mins early.

faqs.q: When will we know team placements?
faqs.a: Offers are typically sent out via email within 48-72 hours after the final tryout session for your age group.

faqs.q: What do I need to be ready for?
faqs.a: Be ready for physical testing (height, reach, vertical) and agility (shuttle run), followed by skill drills. Bring water and knee pads.
